name: 13 Reasons Why
description: High school student Clay Jensen lands in the center of a series of heartbreaking mysteries set in motion by a friend's tragic suicide.

videos.title: Tape 1, Side A
videos.overview: As the school mourns the death of Hannah Baker, her friend Clay receives a box of tapes with messages she recorded before she died by suicide.

videos.title: Tape 1, Side B
videos.overview: Hannah makes friends with Jessica and Alex, two other new students. Justin doesn't show up at school, and Hannah's mother finds something troubling.

videos.title: Tape 2, Side A
videos.overview: Jealousy and gossip take a toll on Hannah's relationships. As Alex struggles with feelings of regret, the guys pressure Clay into getting drunk.

videos.title: Tape 2, Side B
videos.overview: Hannah thinks someone is stalking her and sets a trap. Hannah's mother confronts the principal, and Clay strikes back at someone who wronged Hannah.

videos.title: Tape 3, Side A
videos.overview: Hannah and Clay connect at the school dance, but a crass rumor ruins the mood. Clay takes Courtney to visit Hannah's grave.

videos.title: Tape 3, Side B
videos.overview: Hannah's date on Valentine's Day doesn't go as planned. Alex gets in a big fight at school and has to face the honor board.

videos.title: Tape 4, Side A
videos.overview: Another student sabotages Hannah during a class project. Clay's nightmares about Hannah spill over into the daytime.

videos.title: Tape 4, Side B
videos.overview: Inspired by a friend's poetry reading, Hannah pours her heart out. Tony confides in Clay about the night of Hannah's death.

videos.title: Tape 5, Side A
videos.overview: Hannah witnesses a traumatic event at a summertime party. Clay tries to reason with Justin, and Marcus warns him that the worst is yet to come.

videos.title: Tape 5, Side B
videos.overview: A distraught Hannah gets a ride home from the party. Jessica's behavior grows increasingly erratic, and Clay learns the truth behind a tragedy.

videos.title: Tape 6, Side A
videos.overview: Clay and Hannah grow closer. While Clay spends a heartbreaking night listening to his tape with Tony, tensions boil over at Bryce's house.

videos.title: Tape 6, Side B
videos.overview: Hannah winds up at a party after an argument with her parents. The students are served with subpoenas, and Justin wrestles with conflicting loyalties.

videos.title: Tape 7, Side A
videos.overview: Hannah seeks help from Mr. Porter, the school counselor. Clay plays the new tape for Tony and weighs what to do next.

videos.title: The First Polaroid
videos.overview: Five months after Hannah's death, the case against Liberty goes to trial, with Tyler as the first witness. Clay finds a troubling photo in his locker.

videos.title: Two Girls Kissing
videos.overview: Courtney makes a brave decision. Clay's memories of Hannah drive a wedge between him and Skye. Someone trashes the yearbook office.

videos.title: The Drunk Slut
videos.overview: Worried about threats against them, Alex and Clay urge Jessica to testify about Bryce. Clay enlists Tony's help to find a potential witness.

videos.title: The Second Polaroid
videos.overview: Clay hides a secret from his parents. Concerned about his reputation, Marcus lies in court. Jessica and Alex skip school together.

videos.title: The Chalk Machine
videos.overview: Tyler and Cyrus embrace their outsider status. Alex fights to recover his lost memories. Ryan and Mrs. Baker look to Hannah's poems for clues.

videos.title: The Smile at the End of the Dock
videos.overview: Clay tries to figure out where the Polaroids were taken. Justin shows up at school. Zach's revelation about Hannah takes everyone by surprise.

videos.title: The Third Polaroid
videos.overview: Alex blows up at Bryce. Someone blackmails Marcus. Clay testifies about a night he and Hannah spent together. Jessica experiences a flashback.

videos.title: The Little Girl
videos.overview: When Hannah's parents come under scrutiny, Jessica reaches out to Mrs. Baker. Justin struggles to stay clean. Clay reconnects with Skye.

videos.title: The Missing Page
videos.overview: Tyler goes out with Cyrus's sister. Chloe confronts Bryce about the tapes. Jess wonders if she's ready to date again. Mr. Porter wrestles with regret.

videos.title: Smile, Bitches
videos.overview: Tony opens up about his past. Sheri devises a plan to get into the clubhouse. Mr. Porter tries to help Justin. Zach and Bryce butt heads.

videos.title: Bryce and Chloe
videos.overview: Chaos erupts at school in the aftermath of Bryce's testimony. Jessica tells Chloe about the clubhouse. Alex's memories come rushing back.

videos.title: The Box of Polaroids
videos.overview: Threats against Clay and the others escalate. Tyler faces disciplinary action. Justin testifies about Bryce, putting his own future at risk.

videos.title: Bye
videos.overview: One month later, Hannah's loved ones celebrate her life and find comfort in each other. Meanwhile, a brutal assault pushes one student over the edge.

videos.title: Yeah. I'm the New Girl
videos.overview: The cops question Clay about Bryce's disappearance. Clay remembers the aftermath of Spring Fling, when he raced to cover Tyler's tracks and met Ani.

videos.title: If You're Breathing, You're a Liar
videos.overview: After learning about Chloe's pregnancy, Clay and Ani pay her a visit. Chloe recalls how she leaned on Zach for support -- and that Bryce never knew.

videos.title: The Good Person Is Indistinguishable from the Bad
videos.overview: As the police investigation sets the school on edge, Ani remembers that Jessica confronted Bryce. Growing suspicious of Jess, Ani and Clay follow her.

videos.title: Angry, Young and Man
videos.overview: After Tyler admits he still has a gun, the group keeps tabs on him at school. But their worry deepens when they learn he had a motive to kill Bryce.

videos.title: Nobody's Clean
videos.overview: The police search the school after finding steroids in Bryce's car. Alex remembers how Bryce supported Alex after Jessica dumped him.

videos.title: You Can Tell the Heart of a Man by How He Grieves
videos.overview: The police bring in Tony for questioning. At Bryce's funeral, Ani uncovers two damning secrets.

videos.title: There Are a Number of Problems with Clay Jensen
videos.overview: The police interrogate Justin and Clay about the night Clay pulled a gun on Bryce. Clay discovers that Ani and Bryce's bond ran deeper than he realized.

videos.title: In High School, Even on a Good Day, It's Hard to Tell Who's on Your Side
videos.overview: Mr. Porter interviews students about Clay, who pleads his innocence to Mrs. Walker. Learning Porter counseled Bryce, Clay and Ani question his motives.

videos.title: Always Waiting for the Next Bad News
videos.overview: The cops name Clay as a person of interest in the murder. Ani catches Justin in a lie after learning Bryce bailed him out of a dangerous situation.

videos.title: The World Closing In
videos.overview: Hannah's mother returns to town. Urging Clay to protect himself, she reveals that there was more to Tony and Bryce's relationship than Clay knew.

videos.title: There Are a Few Things I Haven't Told You
videos.overview: As the cops close in on Clay -- their main suspect -- violent confrontations at the homecoming game expose that everyone had a reason to kill Bryce.

videos.title: And Then the Hurricane Hit
videos.overview: The pressure of Clay's arrest leads his friends to make risky decisions, and the full story of the brawl that erupted at homecoming emerges.

videos.title: Let the Dead Bury the Dead
videos.overview: Clay is released on bail, Ani puts a plan to exonerate him into action, and the truth about Bryce's murder finally comes to light.

videos.title: Winter Break
videos.overview: The police question Tyler about the guns, leaving the friends rattled. Winston transfers to Liberty High after getting expelled from Hillcrest.

videos.title: College Tour
videos.overview: After an incident at school, Clay thinks someone's trying to set him up. Zach and Clay land in hot water during a college tour.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: As the school gears up for the Love Is Love dance on Valentine's Day, disturbing phone calls keep Clay from getting in the spirit.

videos.title: Senior Camping Trip
videos.overview: Clay is forced to confront his anxiety on the senior camping trip as a suspicious email threatens to turn the friends against each other.

videos.title: House Party
videos.overview: The Jensens make the boys take a drug test. When the Liberty parents learn about an upcoming party, Clay suspects that they're tracking the students.

videos.title: Thursday
videos.overview: The school goes into lockdown, and Clay, Tony and Justin worry about Tyler's whereabouts.

videos.title: College Interview
videos.overview: Clay's mental health continues to decline as the friends wrestle with difficult emotions during their college admissions interviews.

videos.title: Acceptance/Rejection
videos.overview: In the wake of the lockdown, the school is on edge — and a troubling abuse of power pushes the students to take action.

videos.title: Prom
videos.overview: When the dean begins a new investigation and threatens to cancel prom, the friends decide to confide in their parents ... but not about everything.

videos.title: Graduation
videos.overview: Strengthened by the struggles they've endured, the friends say goodbye to high school and look toward the future.
